# speckit model api

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Remote OpenAI-compatible model discovery and machine-local persistence (feature 079, ADR-0100, T-027): list models from `/v1/models`, select first remote inference name for first role

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit model api <COMMAND>
```
